description: A donut chart with a legend below it naming each device color.
overview: A `PieChart` donut with a `ChartLegend` that lists every slice from `chartConfig`. `chartData` holds one record per device with a `users` count. Pressing a slice shows a tooltip.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and keep `dataKey` and `nameKey` in step with your field names. Add one entry per slice to `chartConfig` with its label and color; the component takes no props.
